rulings.claim: Anthony Notarian owned the premises located at 8127 Cedar Road, Chesterland, Ohio 44026, in Geauga County.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 1 shows a warranty deed granting the Geauga County premises to Anthony Notarian and identifies the Cedar Road tax mailing address.
rulings.evidenceQuote: ANTHONY NOTARIAN the Grantee whose TAX MAILING ADDRESS will be 8127 Cedar Road, Chester Township, Ohio 44026 ... premises, situated in the Township of Chester, County of Geauga and State of Ohio
rulings.judgeReason: The warranty deed shows Anthony Notarian as grantee of the premises at 8127 Cedar Road in Chester Township, Geauga County, Ohio, supporting ownership.

rulings.claim: Anthony Notarian resided at 8127 Cedar Road, Chesterland, Ohio 44026.
rulings.reason: The record identifies Anthony Notarian as being of the Cedar Road address.
rulings.evidenceQuote: ANTHONY NOTARIAN, a single man ("Grantor"), of 8127 Cedar Rd., Chesterland, OH 44026
rulings.judgeReason: The deed identifies Anthony Notarian as 'of 8127 Cedar Rd., Chesterland, OH 44026,' supporting his residence at that address.

rulings.claim: Gino Notarian transferred Anthony Notarian's property to himself.
rulings.reason: The record states that Gino, acting under the power of attorney, transferred Anthony's real properties to himself.
rulings.evidenceQuote: On April 9, 2019, Gino Notarian-acting as an agent for Anthony Notorian under the 2005 General Durable Power of Attorney-transferred the real properties... 8127 Cedar Road... to himself.
rulings.judgeReason: The probate court order states Gino Notarian, acting under power of attorney, transferred the real properties including 8127 Cedar Road to himself.

rulings.claim: The property Gino Notarian transferred to himself was valued around $2 million.
rulings.problem: The bounded excerpts do not support the asserted approximately $2 million value.
rulings.reason: The available cited material discusses the Cedar Road property's $204,000 appraisal and the probate order references over $800,000 in real properties, but no excerpt states that the property transferred to Gino was valued around $2 million.
rulings.judgeReason: The cited record does not support the claim that the property was valued around $2 million; the available excerpts reference a $204,000 appraisal and over $800,000 in real properties, but no $2 million figure.

rulings.claim: The property Gino Notarian transferred to himself included the Cedar Road Property.
rulings.reason: The probate court order expressly includes the Cedar Road property among the properties Gino transferred to himself.
rulings.evidenceQuote: On April 9, 2019, Gino Notarian... transferred the real properties... 8127 Cedar Road, Chesterland, OH 44026 (PPN: 11-244950), to himself.
rulings.judgeReason: The probate court order expressly includes 8127 Cedar Road among the properties Gino transferred to himself.

rulings.claim: Julia Notarian resided at the Cedar Road Property.
rulings.reason: The record states Julia Notarian resided at the house.
rulings.evidenceQuote: It is complainant's understanding that Julia Notarian has resided at the house without paying rent since some time before the death of Anthony Notarian.
rulings.judgeReason: The record states Julia Notarian resided at the house, supporting the claim.

rulings.claim: Charles Rossbach III resided at the Cedar Road Property.
rulings.reason: The deed identifies Charles Rossbach and Julia Notarian as being of the Cedar Road address.
rulings.evidenceQuote: CHARLES R. ROSSBACH, a single man and JULIA M. NOTARIAN ("Grantors"), of 8127 Cedar Rd, Chesterland, OH 44026
rulings.judgeReason: The deed lists Charles R. Rossbach as 'of 8127 Cedar Rd, Chesterland, OH 44026,' indicating his residence there.

rulings.claim: Julia Notarian resided at the Cedar Road Property without paying rent.
rulings.reason: The record states Julia Notarian resided at the house without paying rent.
rulings.evidenceQuote: Julia Notarian has resided at the house without paying rent since some time before the death of Anthony Notarian.
rulings.judgeReason: The record explicitly states Julia Notarian resided at the house without paying rent.
